method: Read-only static analysis: existing trs.cmd.CMD loader writes into a separate Python bytearray, not a live emulator. No game code, emulator state, policy input, actions, reward or training data changed.
author_statement_paraphrase: The author describes eight levels and says the game ends when all are completed.

verified_spans.interpretation: Increment the level counter, compare against 9, jump to GAME OVER if equal; otherwise update the level HUD.
Read the level word and write five formatted digits to visible video addresses 0x3c3b through 0x3c3f.
Write GAME OVER to visible character row 10, starting at 0x3e9c.

conclusion: The unmodified game ends after level 8; the internal counter becomes 9 but the game-over branch skips the HUD update. Displayed Level 9 and Level 10 are not attainable through normal gameplay.
measurement_limitation: The current tooling reports terminal GAME OVER and highest displayed level, without distinguishing final-level victory from loss. A zero count of transitions to level 9 is not evidence of zero wins. No all-eight-level victory has been verified.
scope_decision_required: Choose beating all eight original levels (with an independently verified screen-derived win criterion) or explicitly authorize a changed game containing levels 9 and 10. Do not silently change the requested target or the game.
